name: tw-quicksketch
description: Draw it. Guess it.\ A web platform where creativity and intuition meet in a drawing challenge. ## Overview QuickSketch is a full-stack web application where registered users can create sketches by choosing a word from a predefined set and drawing it on a canvas within a limited amount of time. Once published, sketches become available to other users, who can try to guess the associated word with up to 10 attempts.
